description: Deletes a deployment and its underlying app VM, with the data kept on that machine (its named volumes): the only way kept data is deleted, so ask the user first. Pass the numeric id from list_deployments. IMPORTANT: its managed datastores are NOT deleted (data safety): its database, Redis and Qdrant keep running and billing, and this tool returns each id so you can delete_database / delete_relational_database / delete_redis / delete_qdrant them when you're done with the data. Cannot be undone.
name: delete_deployment
title: Delete deployment
